_comment: Selectable models for the rating engine and the Settings dropdown. Edit here to add/rename a model or change a label - no Python change needed. 'default' must be a key of 'models'. If this file is missing or malformed, rate_engine.py falls back to a built-in copy so the engine never breaks.

models.claude-fable-5-1: Fable 5.1 - most capable; slowest and dearest
models.claude-sonnet-5: Sonnet 5 - cheaper, good for bulk re-runs
models.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001: Haiku 4.5 - fastest/cheapest; screening only, not a rating view
